title: CommandReply
description: Direct response on the authenticated command channel. Read data never enters SSE or mutation dedupe.

CommandOutcome.description: Immediate disposition of a client command, delivered on the event channel.

EngineErrorCategory.description: Stable error categories used across engine boundaries.

EngineEvent.description: Events streamed to clients and persisted in the session event log.

oneOf.description: Paged historical content is available; no durable replay cursor is implied.

Human-facing title selected asynchronously after the first successful
assistant turn. This is durable so replay and session lists agree.

A plugin-originated user message was admitted through the bounded
machine boundary. The ordinary message/turn events remain authoritative
for conversation reconstruction.
Session-local status text published by an approved plugin.
Session-local UI notification published by an approved plugin.
Replaceable operational display state, excluded from the durable journal.

Redacted mutation preview retained independently of whether the active
permission mode needed to ask the user. This keeps inline review
available under remembered approvals and YOLO without coupling display
state to a permission dialog.

context_window_known.description: False when zero capacity means unknown rather than exhausted.

oneOf.description:
Connection-scoped boundary for one compaction provider attempt.
This never enters the durable session sequence.

Connection-scoped provider text produced while a compaction summary is
generated. This never enters the durable session sequence.
Connection-scoped provider reasoning produced during compaction.

Accounting for one billed compaction provider attempt that did not
produce the committed summary. This event is deliberately non-terminal:
fallback attempts continue inside the same compaction transaction.
Connection-scoped child progress. This is never appended to the parent log.

definition_fingerprint.description: BLAKE3 hash of the canonical mode semantics.

mode.description: Session-local override. `None` restores the configured policy.

provider.description:
Exact provider route selected for this session, or `None` for the
alias's automatic fallback chain.

thinking.description:
Durable per-session effort applied to this selection, including
concrete provider/model routes.

oneOf.description:
The user explicitly chose to start the selected model without prior
conversation. System and project instructions remain available.

CommandAckMeta.description: Metadata for immediate command acknowledgements before session sequencing.

ClientId.description: Stable identifier of a connected client.

RequestId.description: Client-generated identifier used to correlate a command.

SessionId.description: Stable identifier of an engine session.

TranscriptView.description: Exact canonical prefix interpreted by a complete semantic view.

TranscriptGeneration.description: Current semantic ordering generation, changed by rewind.

SequenceId.description: Monotonic per-session sequence encoded as a decimal string on the wire.

TranscriptOrdinal.description: Logical row position, distinct from a canonical event sequence.

TranscriptItemId.description: Stable item identity, independent of its current logical ordinal.

TurnId.description: Stable identifier of a conversation turn.

TranscriptContent.description: Bounded, renderer-independent content of one stable logical transcript row.

TurnStatus.description: Terminal state of an agent turn.

Usage.description: Provider-reported token accounting normalized by the router.

Cost.description:
Provider-neutral billing/quota disposition for a completed turn. A missing
price is never represented as a zero-dollar API charge.

Role.description: A provider-neutral role in the conversation IR.

TranscriptConversationBlock.description: Displayable conversation content; provider continuation signatures stay in IR.

TranscriptBodyPreview.description: A bounded prefix with an authoritative source for the complete body.

TranscriptPreviewFormat.description: Preview syntax. Incomplete JSON is display text and must not be parsed as JSON.

TranscriptContentSource.description: Body location within the exact journal prefix carried by its enclosing view.

TranscriptContentSelector.description: A closed selector into one canonical event. It never names a filesystem path.

ToolInvocationId.description: Host-owned identity of one tool execution, independent of provider call IDs.

TranscriptToolStatus.description: Tool invocation lifecycle independent of provider call/result IR placement.

SubagentId.description: Stable identifier of a child agent session.

TranscriptSubagentStatus.description: Child lifecycle without retaining its full historical event projection.

SubagentStatus.description: Terminal disposition of one child-agent invocation.

ContextSnapshot.description: Exact engine-side context breakdown for one assembled request.

context_window_known.description: False when zero capacity means unknown rather than exhausted.

context_window_reason.description: Provider-neutral explanation for an unknown context window.

CacheBreakpoint.description: One explicit cache boundary after an assembled item.

ContextItemId.description: Stable identifier of one assembled context item.

ContextItemSnapshot.description: Per-item token and surgery state shown by context inspectors.

machine_local_path.description: Machine-local provenance only; remote clients must not dereference it.

ContextItemKind.description: Semantic class of one assembled prompt item.

ContextItemState.description: Orthogonal surgery markers for one context item.

CostSnapshot.description: Session-level cost, token, cache, and burn-rate snapshot.

TurnAccounting.description: Usage and billing attributed to one completed agent turn.

AccountingAttribution.description: Runtime role to which usage and cost are attributed.

SessionReview.description: Complete replacement snapshot for the cumulative session review reducer.

SessionReviewFile.description: One deterministic workspace-relative entry in a cumulative session review.

ReviewFileStatus.description: Durable disposition of one file in the cumulative session review.

ReviewFileDecision.description: Driver decision for one file in the cumulative session review.

PromptDump.description: Exact assembled model request exposed for prompt transparency.

ModelAlias.description: Provider-blind model alias resolved by the engine router.

Turn.description: One conversation turn in the internal message representation.

ToolCallId.description: Stable identifier assigned to a model tool call.

ToolOutput.description: Provider-neutral output produced by a tool.

ToolOutputPart.description: One part of a mixed tool result.

ImageRef.description: An image reference that does not assume a filesystem shared with a client.

TurnMeta.description: Metadata whose meaning is independent of a provider adapter.

PromptTool.description: Provider-neutral tool definition included in a prompt dump.

SessionDescriptor.description: One active or resumable session returned by the engine host.

SubagentDescriptor.description: Human-readable child metadata exposed only through its owning parent.

SubagentIsolation.description: Filesystem isolation selected for one child agent.

oneOf.description: Run in a private detached Git worktree and return a diff artifact.
Share the parent workspace. This requires the parent's ordinary write approvals.

SubagentActivity.description: Current parent-visible lifecycle state of a retained child agent.

CommandSource.description: One slash command exposed to fuzzy pickers without UI-private metadata.

ModeDescriptor.description: One bounded, credential-free interaction mode exposed to clients.

ModeId.description: Open identifier of a built-in or extension-provided mode.

ModelDescriptor.description: One concrete provider/model discovered from a live authenticated catalog.

provider.description:
Sanitized logical provider name. Adapter kind, endpoint, and auth
material remain behind the provider boundary.

aliases.description: Configured role aliases which currently include this concrete model.

ModelCapabilities.description: Provider-neutral capabilities used by model pickers and attachment checks.

ModelCacheBehavior.description: Prompt-cache behavior exposed without leaking a provider implementation.

ModelAliasDescriptor.description: Small provider-blind role mapping shown separately from the live catalog.

ProviderAuthKind.description:
Sanitized provider inventory row. Credentials, endpoints, and adapter
implementation details never cross this boundary.

ProviderNextAction.description: Exact safe action offered for one provider inventory row.

UserSettingDescriptor.description: One engine-mediated user setting exposed to interactive clients.

McpServerDescriptor.description: One server in the live session MCP inventory.

McpServerState.description:
Bounded live state of one MCP server. Transport credentials and process
environment are intentionally never exposed on the interactive protocol.

RuntimeServiceDescriptor.description:
One credential-free process identity currently serving the active session.

Configured-but-idle integrations are deliberately absent. Names are short
executable identities, never command lines, arguments, paths, or output.

RuntimeServiceKind.description: Live service categories projected to clients.

McpApprovalReview.description: Exact, redacted configuration identity presented before MCP approval.

PermissionStateDescriptor.description: Bounded permission inventory for one live session.

effective_rules.description: Effective immutable rules assembled from trusted user configuration.

project_rules.description:
Project rule authority is intentionally empty while project permission
config remains forbidden; the typed field makes that policy explicit.

session_rules.description: Ephemeral rules added by the current session's driver.

PermissionDecision.description: Default permission decision used when no rule matches.

oneOf.description: Ask the active driver for approval.
Allow the operation.
Deny the operation.

PermissionModeDescriptor.description: Active session permission mode shared by configuration, engine, and clients.

PermissionRuleDescriptor.description: Stable, typed rule row rendered by permission-management clients.

id.description: Opaque stable id accepted by remove operations. Clients never rebuild it.

PermissionApprovalDescriptor.description:
Opaque remembered approval metadata. Invocation arguments and fingerprints
are deliberately absent.

PermissionApprovalScope.description: Scope of a remembered exact approval.

ProviderAuthAttemptId.description: Connection-scoped identifier of one provider authentication attempt.

ProviderAuthChallenge.description:
Sanitized, connection-scoped authentication prompt. This is never a
durable session event and contains no token or credential value.

WorkspaceFileMatch.description: Relative workspace path returned by fuzzy file search.

WorkspaceFilePreview.description: Remote-safe in-band file preview; paths are always workspace-relative.

AttachmentData.description: In-band attachment data; protocol messages never require shared files.

WorkspaceStatus.description: Workspace status for the TUI status line and file picker.

WorkspaceDiff.description: Bounded current-worktree diff for one exact workspace-relative path.

EventMeta.description: Metadata common to persisted and streamed events.

WorkspaceRootDescriptor.description:
One stable session workspace root. Durable/wire events use only virtual
`@root/N` paths; canonical host paths stay in private local metadata.

StoredAttachment.description: Durable content-addressed attachment metadata persisted in the event log.

UnrestorablePath.description: A workspace path that a rewind could not restore exactly.

ToolProgress.description: Replaceable display state; never authoritative tool output or a durable record.

ProgressAmount.description: Optional bounded work-count observation. It cannot grant more execution time.

ToolCapability.description: Capabilities used by the permission engine for a tool invocation.

UnifiedDiff.description: Optional structured unified diff attached to a mutating-tool approval.

ToolOutputStream.description: A stream associated with partial output from a running tool.

QuestionId.description: Stable identifier of an interactive question.

Question.description: A typed question sent to an interactive client.

model_switch.description: Present only when this question gates a model switch.

QuestionResponseKind.description: Shape of a response accepted for an interactive question.

QuestionOption.description: A selectable response to an engine question.

model_context_transfer.description: Present only for the three typed model-context transfer choices.

ModelContextTransfer.description: Explicit handling of existing conversation context when changing models.

oneOf.description: Compact the current conversation, then give the summary to the new model.
Keep the complete current conversation for the new model.
Retain only system/project instructions and start a fresh conversation.

ModelSwitchQuestion.description:
Target retained in a durable model-switch interaction until the user chooses
how existing context should cross the model boundary.

Answer.description: One answer returned for a question entry.

ProviderCallIdentity.description: Host-assigned logical call identity plus a distinct provider attempt.

session_id.description: Session which owns the provider request.

turn_id.description: Durable agent turn which owns this request.

attribution.description: Separates ordinary generation from compaction, title, and child usage.

call_id.description: Bounded host-generated identity, never a model-supplied tool identifier.

attempt.description: Retries under a logical call must increment this value.

ProviderCallActuals.description: Provider-reported actuals; a missing or ambiguous terminal is never represented as zero.

usage.description: Normalized input, output, cache and reasoning usage.

cost.description: Normalized monetary, credit, subscription, or unavailable accounting.

BudgetScope.description: Scope whose spend triggered a budget transition.

BudgetUnit.description: Billing unit evaluated by a budget guardrail.

SubagentResult.description: Predictable result returned from `spawn_agent` and workflow agent steps.

DiffArtifact.description: Complete durable patch returned by an isolated child.

TouchedFile.description: A path affected by an isolated child patch.

TouchedFileStatus.description: Git change kind retained in a child diff manifest.

PlanArtifact.description: Durable plan submitted before entering execute mode.

PlanStep.description: One verifiable step in a model-submitted plan artifact.

PlanDecision.description: Driver response to a submitted plan.

ThinkingLevel.description: Provider-neutral thinking effort selected by a model alias or session.

oneOf.description: Do not request provider reasoning output.
Prefer the provider's least expensive reasoning mode.
Prefer a balanced reasoning mode.
Prefer the provider's strongest reasoning mode.

ShellId.description: Engine-generated identifier of one foreground user shell.
